title: 云计算和 SaaS 行业的最新进展和结构性变化
core_insight: AWS、Salesforce、Google Cloud 和 Azure 等云计算巨头在 AI、数据分析和网络安全方面有所进展，而 SaaS 厂商如 HubSpot 则在营销自动化和 AI 应用方面有所创新

dimension_texts.infrastructure: AWS 和 Google Cloud 扩展了其区域覆盖和算力供应 Kog 致力于从 GPU 中挤出更多的推理能力，Google Cloud 更新了其芯片和 GPU 供应 AWS Weekly Roundup: Price reduction of GPT models in Bedrock, CloudWatch managed collectors for Prometheus metrics, and more (August 3, 2026) Kog is going deeper to squeeze more inference out of GPUs Expanding connectivity in the Americas: Introducing Alisios, Canoa, and OlaLuz subsea cables
